verdicts.reason: Both swell the white card to cover about 80% of the canvas, leaving a huge empty white gap between the header and the headline. In both, the card bleeds off the right/top edge, the dunes art is mostly hidden, and the headline is set on one line, much smaller than the original's bold two-line lockup, with tiny body copy. A at least keeps logo-left / CTA-right header order. B puts the CTA before the logo (wrong reading order), places the logo arbitrarily and leaves the card's right edge cut off.
